EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR VACANCY The Wisconsin Retired Educators’ Association (WREA) Board of Directors is announcing a vacancy for the position of Executive Director. The WREA is an issue-driven organization representing the interests of Wisconsin’s retired educational community. The WREA Office is in Middleton, WI and serves the statewide membership of more than 6,000 retired educators. Essential to successfully carrying out this full-time role is a strong commitment to supporting public education and to Prek-16 educators. The cover letter must share the applicant’s knowledge of WREA, a non-profit, non-partisan entity. Please share how you can support and promote WREA’s mission. The Executive Director reports to the Board of Directors and manages the affairs of the Association, implements policies and directives of the Board, supervises and evaluates the work of staff. The Executive Director develops and maintains relationships with affiliated local, state and national organizations and a registered lobbyist for WREA. Salary: Based on Experience plus negotiated benefits. Responsibilities of the Executive Director Include: Assume a leadership role in working with the President, Board of Directors, Executive Council, and WREA Foundation Trustees to promote the association’s purposes and goals and implement its policies and programs Coordinate lobbying efforts with the chair of the legislative committee and be a registered lobbyist Serve as Membership Committee chairperson per By-laws, to help maintain its membership, and promote membership growth Manage the WREA office, including the employment of other staff Assume responsibility for communications and publications of WREA Manage the daily financial affairs of WREA See job description below for details. Click the link to apply https://wrea.net/page/WREAExecutiveDirector Required Qualifications : Degree in Public Administration, Educational Administration, or related educational field Understanding of 401(c) (4) nonprofit organization Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience in developing, writing, and executing a strategic plan Note: For more information about WREA, please visit our website at www.wrea.net . Required Application Packet must include : A cover letter that includes your knowledge of the Wisconsin Retired Educators’ Association and the public employee pension. A resume which reflects your qualifications, experiences and skills for the position. The names, street addresses, telephone numbers and email addresses of three references. Application Packet must be submitted by: October 21, 2026 Incomplete or late applications will not be considered Please note that given the anticipated interest in this position, the names of applicants may be released at some time during the hiring process and there will be background checks. The WREA is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on sex, creed, color, national origin, disability, age or sexual orientation.
